 Software Engineer Intern
 About Mytra: 
 We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. 

 About the role 
 The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how, and in what sequence, in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests. 

 This internship owns one piece of that: the integration layer between Mytra and a customer's system. Every Mytra deployment has to exchange work with whatever the customer already runs. You will build, own and test the middleware layer that makes those touch points work 
 What you’ll do: 
 
• Build the middleware that sits between Mytra's system and a customer's, translating the work they send us, and the state we send back. 
• Map a customer’s worksite’s workflow onto Mytra’s, and find the places where the two don’t line up. 
• Design robust solutions to all touch points: what happens on a message we don't understand, a missed message, a request that arrives twice, or a system that goes quiet mid-exchange? 
• Build the test coverage that proves the integration works without needing a live customer system on the other end. 

 Ideal Candidates 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in computer science, software engineering, or a related field. 
• Comfortable in at least one backend language (Go, Python, Java, C++ or similar) and willing to work in Go. 
• You have built something that talks to something else: an API, a service, a protocol, an app. Coursework and personal projects count! 
• You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently. 
• You are not afraid to ask questions early and often. 
• You can own a scoped piece of work without daily pair programming. 
• You care whether your code is correct, and you write the tests that would catch you being wrong. Nice to have: 
 
• Experience with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres. 
• Message pub/sub technologies like NATS, Kafka, MQTT, or similar. 
• Any experience making two systems talk that were not designed for each other. 
• Exposure to warehouse, logistics or supply chain software. 
• An interest in algorithms, scheduling or optimization problems. 
• Prior internship, research, lab or competition experience. A Final Note: 
 If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last 
 Benefits Include: 
 
• Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high-growth company backed by top-tier VCs 
• Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents 
• 401(k) plans and employer-subsidized life insurance 
• Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table 
• Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together 
• Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity 
• Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity 
• Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit 
• Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases 
• Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters Pay Notice 
 Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change. 

 This role requires on-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams. 

 Apply now

About AppLovin 

 AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com .

 To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others. 

 About Gist 

 Gist is a new consumer social app built by AppLovin, a handbook for the curious. We’re building a lifestyle platform for adults 25–45 around the relatable, actionable content people use to navigate their daily lives: food, wellness, fashion, family, and personal finance. We’re building our creator ecosystem from the ground up, and we’re looking for an intern to help us find the talent that will define it.

The best outcome of this internship is seeing the partnerships you build contribute to Gist’s growth.

 About the Role 

 This is a research and pipeline role sitting at the center of our platform partnerships team. You won’t be filing decks or sitting in on calls. You’ll be doing the ground-level work that makes creator partnership recruitment possible: finding the right talent, agency, growth platforms, tracking outreach, and keeping our partnership database sharp and current. 

 A Day in the Life 

• Research and identify potential partners across creators, brands, agencies, and communities that can help grow Gist 

• Support partner outreach by drafting communications, coordinating follow-ups, and tracking responses 

• Maintain our partnership pipeline, keeping contacts, opportunities, status, and next steps organized and up to date 

• Evaluate potential partners based on audience fit, strategic relevance, and growth potential 

• Surface emerging trends and partnership opportunities that could strengthen Gist’s content, community, and reach 

• Build and automate workflows using AI tools to improve research, outreach, and pipeline management 

• Track and report on partnership performance using data and KPIs to measure impact on Gist’s growth 

 Who You Are 

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Science, Computer Science, Business or any related fields graduating December 2027 or Spring 2028 

• Strong AI skills and genuine interest in building automation workflows 

• Comfortable with data: you think in metrics, track what you do, and can connect your work to measurable outcomes 

• A clear, confident communicator who adapts quickly and is receptive to feedback 

• Curious about how platform partnerships work: the deal structures, the pitch, the relationship-building 

• Sharp, flexible thinker who can pivot quickly as priorities shift 

• Prior experience in influencer marketing, talent management, or creator-focused roles is a plus 

 Why Join 

• A front-row seat to how a well-funded platform builds its creator ecosystem from zero 

• Direct exposure to the full creator partnership lifecycle: sourcing, outreach, negotiation, and onboarding 

• Mentorship from a senior creator partnerships team with deep roots in talent agencies and management 

• Real, meaningful work from day one: the creators you find could end up shaping what Gist becomes 

• Opportunity for full-time conversion for exceptional performers 
 AppLovin provides a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance rewards approach. Total compensation at AppLovin is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Depending on the position offered, equity, and other forms of incentive compensation (as applicable) may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to dental, vision, and other benefits.
